summary: Checked both estimates against their cited PDF pages after reading the complete markdown conversion, including all end matter; the article has no appendix. All recorded statistics, arm assignments, and counts are supported. PDF p. 12, Table 6 prints creativity adjusted means 4.71 and 4.35, SEs 0.18 and 0.17, and analyzed student counts 36 and 38. The reported total of 74 on PDF p. 1 matches these arm counts. Table 5 on PDF p. 12 prints the Group / Creativity test F(1, 69) = 7.216, p = .009, and eta-squared .096. Table 3 on PDF p. 9 prints creativity slopes 0.315 and 0.210 with SEs 0.006 and 0.010; no analysis-specific growth-model counts or between-arm slope test are printed, so the corresponding nulls are appropriate. The script warning is a false positive: PDF text inserts a U+200B zero-width space between the Table 6 experimental-row count 36 and the Control row. Removing that invisible character and normalizing whitespace reproduces the recorded quote exactly on the cited page. The requested coding fields agree with the methods: expert-rated overall creativity of student products made during continuing AI-supported coursework, compared between separate groups. No additional in-scope numerical outcome or contrast was found. Figure 1 was inspected in memory and has no numerical labels on its plotted points. Separate analytical-task scores, baseline intercepts, association analyses, and experimental-group-only process analyses are appropriately excluded. The extraction already records the unresolved number of randomized classes, absent class-adjusted uncertainty, unspecified MANCOVA outcome occasion, and unclear growth time unit. Those source limitations remain unresolved; the participant se_basis describes the reported analysis and does not establish valid precision for randomized classes or eligibility under the minimum-cluster rule.
